history.summary: Plan completed and committed (ab6ed27): cross-cutting shape, P1-P3 in JenkinsPipelineUtils (pin + pure-function tests; hasChanges @NonCPS + dead code; podYaml helper), P4 converting KubeCoder/Jenkinsfile (github: target, held, linter-gated), 12 acceptance criteria. One question: R1 lists when{}/post{} but KubeCoder's Jenkinsfile has no conditional or failure/cleanup logic for them to carry — plan is drafted on option A (convert faithfully, add neither), which needs a ruling to reword V01.

Ruling D3 applied (commit on AnsibleSpecs): V01 drops when{}/post{} and records the faithful conversion with Jenkinsfile:31-340 evidence; P4 cites D3. Citations re-verified at unchanged HEADs (library 276beff, KubeCoder 5bbf14bf); dry-run parses 4 phases, the KubeCoder hold and its linter gate ruling.

Two findings. The operator should rule whether D2's run-push covers P3's rewrite of the sidecar methods about 110 pipelines call, since no gate checks what they return. Blocking: the plan relies on the linter to keep the inherited kaniko template, but the controller's kaniko template is YAML-only and the plugin's default Override merge drops it from a declarative yaml agent, so the operator's Replay would fail at the first kaniko stage.

Rulings F1 and F2 applied (AnsibleSpecs commit): P3 is now a standalone @NonCPS `podYaml templates:, images:` helper with the images: key spelling settled (string, or map with image/name/resources/runAsUser/env) and containerTemplates.* untouched; P4 sets yamlMergeStrategy merge() and names the two F1-accepted pod differences (node pulls Always, golang/node kept alive by sleep infinity); V01, V03, V05 follow. Dry run parses 4 phases, the KubeCoder hold and its linter gate ruling.
